written.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon model for complex workflows
written.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, a new model positioned between Hydrogen and Carbon in the Gemini 4 lineup for software engineering, knowledge work, and science. The model features a 1 million-token context window and is priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.
